request: Add a settings page for a signed-in user. It needs somewhere to edit their display name and bio, a set of switches for which email notifications they receive, and a clearly separated area at the bottom for deleting their account.

expect.note: A new page plus three sections a review would name out loud (profile, notifications, danger zone). Fewer than 4 creates is under-decomposition — the defect AAQ-008 was written to fix.

operations.intent: New page for a signed-in user to manage their account: edit display name and bio, toggle email notification preferences, and delete their account in a clearly separated danger zone at the bottom. Composed of bands: profile info band, notifications band, and a visually distinct delete-account band.
Form card for editing the signed-in user's display name and bio, with a save action.

outputs.name: saved
outputs.description: fired when the user saves changes

operations.intent: A set of labelled switches letting the user choose which email notifications they receive, drawing one Notification Preference Row per preference via a Repeater.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: emitted with updated preference key/value when a switch is toggled

operations.intent: A single row showing a notification type label and its on/off switch.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: whether this notification is currently enabled

outputs.name: toggled
outputs.description: new enabled state when the switch is flipped

operations.intent: Clearly separated, visually distinct danger-zone band at the bottom of the settings page with a delete-account button and confirmation step.

outputs.name: deleteConfirmed
outputs.description: fired when the user confirms account deletion

operations.intent: Add a link/button to navigate to the new /Pages/Settings page so a signed-in user can reach their settings from their profile card.
Register /Pages/Settings in the Page Router's routes alongside existing pages; startPage remains unchanged. /Pages/Settings becomes reachable via navigation from the Public Profile Card.

advisories.message: /Visual Components/Settings/Notification Preferences repeats over static rows carrying "label", "key", "enabled". Those field names are the contract: whichever component draws one row must expose Component Inputs with exactly those names, or the repeater will render identical rows.
